notes: Client-only JavaScript/TSL sample; no native, runtime-host, C++ or RTX changes are required.
Camera permission is requested on startup for immediate gesture control; camera=0 keeps the procedural preview offline.
Camera frames remain local: RGB is converted to YCbCr first, then a skin-seeded connected foreground matte reveals only the moving person proxy rather than the raw room.
The broad person display matte and detailed skin-colour diffusion plus motion-seeding hand mask remain separate so body filling cannot damage fingertip or gesture shape tracking.
Only camera-derived hand motion and openness drive the interaction; pointer input is deliberately not wired.
Four camera-only modes are explicit: priority POINT follows the fingertip and arms the sequence, CLOSED charges and compresses, OPEN releases a bright shockwave, and SWIPE throws ribbons.
Persistent WebGPU particles use additive soft sprites and a bloom pipeline with a direct-render fallback.
